renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium choice-reversible-step shared-world guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Use the same-sign human-visually-approved B083 PNG under apps/stella/private/guardian-art-production/choice-protected-value-shared-world/ as the mandatory primary two-guardian identity, white-sclera purple-eye, relative-scale, palette and rendering anchor; use B085 and B086 only as reversible-device continuity references and never copy their staging. Show exactly the two named guardians, or exactly the canonical internal pair for Gemini and Pisces, and no third guardian, adviser, user figure, audience, future self, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or implied person. Preserve canonical bodies, colors, signature features, dark-purple outlines and visible chest Stella stars. Eye construction is a hard gate: require approved white sclera, matched purple irises, coherent pupils and gaze aimed at one intended target, and consistent highlights; reject button eyes, crossed or targetless divergent gaze, duplicated or warped eyes, mismatched iris size, and any eye identity drift. The pair plus one bounded reversible trial setting covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Give each guardian one independent reversible control with its own grip and release point; neither guardian touches or operates the other's control. Keep a broad, unmistakable transfer-and-retrieval interval between their hands, controls and any neutral sample so exchange, acceptance, ownership, continuation and return remain uncompleted and independently retractable. Every trial remains half-set, removable, unlatched, unsupported at one end or stopped before completion; never imply hierarchy, proxy decision, compulsory help, consensus, irreversible commitment, success, correct result, certainty, destiny or guaranteed outcome. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, hourglass, calendar grid, map, coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Every ledge, support, fork, tray, recess, clip, shutter, brace and connector stays broken, open-sided, notched, loose, removable or unlatched. No connected path, literal key, cord knot, closed circle, ring, halo, portal, infinity sign, cage, locked box or deterministic direction. Do not add a scale. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. Keep every composition distinct from B001–86 and from the other eleven cards. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor with visible paper grain, rounded plush proportions and dreamy violet-peach-gold lighting; no naturalistic-animal drift, rough crayon, flat vector, readable text, logo or watermark.
